title: Statement of cash flows — Lakeview Supply
instructions: Lakeview Supply uses the **indirect method**. Using the exhibits, complete the operating section and classify the listed transactions. Enter amounts as whole dollars; enter decreases in cash as negative numbers.

exhibits.title: Comparative balance sheet data
exhibits.content:
| Account | Dec 31, Year 1 | Dec 31, Year 2 |
|---|---:|---:|
| Cash | 42,000 | 61,000 |
| Accounts receivable, net | 88,000 | 103,000 |
| Inventory | 130,000 | 118,000 |
| Prepaid insurance | 6,000 | 9,000 |
| Equipment | 400,000 | 440,000 |
| Accumulated depreciation | (160,000) | (170,000) |
| Accounts payable | 74,000 | 81,000 |
| Wages payable | 12,000 | 10,000 |
| Notes payable (long-term) | 150,000 | 120,000 |
| Common stock | 100,000 | 130,000 |
| Additional paid-in capital | 100,000 | 100,000 |
| Retained earnings | 70,000 | 120,000 |

exhibits.title: Year 2 additional information
exhibits.content:
- Net income for Year 2 was **$85,000**.
- Equipment with a cost of **$60,000** and accumulated depreciation of **$45,000** was sold for **$20,000** cash.
- New equipment was purchased for cash.
- Cash dividends of **$35,000** were declared and paid.
- Common stock was issued for cash.
- A note payable principal payment was made in cash.

rows.label: Depreciation expense
rows.explanation: Accumulated depreciation roll-forward: beginning 160,000 − 45,000 (removed on sale) + depreciation = ending 170,000, so depreciation = **55,000**. Add back.

rows.label: (Gain) or loss on sale of equipment
rows.explanation: Carrying amount 60,000 − 45,000 = 15,000; proceeds 20,000 → gain of 5,000. **Subtract** it (enter −5,000); the proceeds are investing.

rows.label: Net cash provided by operating activities

parts.prompt: Compute the investing and financing amounts.

rows.label: Net change in cash (should agree with the balance sheets)
rows.explanation: 134,000 − 80,000 − 35,000 = **19,000**, which agrees with cash rising from 42,000 to 61,000.

parts.prompt: Classify each Year 2 item as it would appear in Lakeview's statement of cash flows.

rows.label: Interest paid on the note payable
rows.explanation: Interest paid is operating under U.S. GAAP.

rows.label: Proceeds from sale of equipment
rows.explanation: Full proceeds from PP&E sales are investing.

rows.label: Hypothetical (not part of the exhibits): had Lakeview acquired a delivery van by signing a 3-year note to the dealer, with no cash paid
rows.explanation: Asset acquired with debt, no cash — disclose as a noncash investing and financing activity. (In the actual Year 2 facts, all equipment was bought for cash and notes payable only decreased.)
